Class passwordRecognizer

java.lang.Object
guiTools.passwordRecognizer
public class passwordRecognizer extends Object

Title: FSM-translated PasswordRecognizer.

Description: A demonstration of the mechanical translation of Finite State Machine diagram into an executable Java program using the Password Recognizer. The code detailed design is based on a while loop with a select list

Copyright: Lynn Robert Carter © 2024

Version:
1.00 2024-09-13 Initial baseline derived from the Even Recognizer, 1.01 2024-09-17 Correction to address UNChar coding error, improper error message, and improve internal documentation, 4.00 2026-09-29 Rewritten for implementation into TP1
Author:
Lynn Robert Carter, Sierra Trimmer

      public static String checkForValidPassword(String input)
      This method is a mechanical transformation of a Finite State Machine diagram into a Java method.
      Parameters:
      input - The input string for the Finite State Machine
      Returns:
      An output string that is empty if every things is okay or it is a String with a helpful description of the error
